reviews.text: I am the owner of Boulder Hypnosis Works. I have been a coach and hypnotherapist for over 20 years. As a sometimes mentor, I have observed Nick grow so much as a coach and a human being, using his creative problem-solving skills and deep empathy to help his clients achieve their health goals. I would wholeheartedly recommend Nick as a health coach.

I had several goals but didn't know where to start. Nick helped me achieve them all!  I wanted to lose weight and Nicholas was a great help because he is very knowledgeable about foods and exercise, and his kind and gentle approach worked for me.  I also wanted to declutter my house and finish writing my book. My book is now published!  Decluttering might be an unusual problem to present to a coach, but his coaching helped with this too.  What a kind and wonderful person he is!  He never tells you what to do, but helps you decide what actions you can take that will achieve your goals.

I have been working with Nick Dunbar, Hypothesis Coaching, for my pre-diabetics, MCS, Multiple Chemical Sensitivity, and aging issues. He has helped me make significant changes in my health.  My A1C numbers are almost to the normal range now and I have lost 15 pounds as well.  My short-term memory has returned to normal.  So nice to have "me" back. He has helped me figure out how to get detoxed and which diet and protocols to use to get my MCS (Started with Mercury poisoning) on the road to recovery. It is a long haul for that particular problem.
Nick's such a kind, caring, intelligent, professional coach. He is professionally trained with ACE and has a very large knowledge base.  He can help with losing weight, handling pain, anxiety, making goals like staying on tract after losing weight, getting a job, helping graduating sons or daughters choose a school, or organizing the house or projects.
I am very happy I asked him for help.

I have been working with Nick for many months on a weekly basis. He is knowledgeable, thoughtful, caring, and works with you to reach consensual agreement to try new ways to improve to achieve your goals. I’m diabetic and overweight, and during my time with Nick my blood sugar has dropped to nearly normal readings and I have lost 20 pounds. My health an mental outlook has improved considerably. I would recommend working with Nick!

Nick is genuinely passionate about helping people to be their best selves and set them on a better path.  As an inspirational and compassionate coach Nick is just what my mom needed to accomplish her goals and move on from unhealthy patterns.  I'm deeply grateful for his positive influence, and so is my family.  Thank you, Nick!
